name: Name
bye: ps4commander has been shut down. You can close this page.
unsafeWarn: Changing files in /system, /dev and similar places can make the console unusable. Enable only if you know what you are doing.
e_protected: This folder is protected and cannot be changed
e_unsafe: System area. Enable "Allow changes in system areas" in the menu first.
e_into_self: Cannot copy a folder into itself
e_same_path: Source and destination are the same
findLabel: Name or mask (e.g. *.txt) in the current folder and below:
truncNote: Search stopped early; narrow the query or the folder.
tooBig: File is larger than 1 MB: editing is not possible. Use download.
binaryNoEdit: This looks like a binary file; editing is disabled.
e_task_exists: The system already has a task for this package (left from an earlier installation). Delete it in Notifications > Downloads and try again.
pkgWarnText: The folder of this package and its subfolders will now be searched for patches and DLC of the same game.
pkgWarnNet: Searching over the network can take a while.
pkgFindingText: Searching this folder and its subfolders for patches, DLC and other files of the same game...
pkgRelHead: Found for {tid} {title}. Tick what to install (the order is fixed: game, patches, DLC, localizations).
pkgTrunc: The search was cut short (too many files), some packages may be missing.
zipStarted: Folder download started as a ZIP archive (built on the fly, no temporary files)
smbPassKeep: (leave empty to keep the saved one)
smbDelQ: Remove the saved connection "{n}"? Files on the server are not touched.
e_smb_share: Share not found on the server
e_ECONNREFUSED: Connection refused (is SMB enabled on the server?)
e_ETIMEDOUT: Server did not answer in time
e_ECONNRESET: Connection to the server was lost
installSmbNote: The package is on a network folder: it is read through a FUSE folder, without copying (needs a supported firmware). If that is not possible, copy it to the console with F5 and install from there. The installation speed depends directly on the connection type; a LAN cable is recommended.
e_smb_enum: Could not get the list of shares (try entering the name manually)
helpBody:
Tab - switch panel
Up/Down/PgUp/PgDn/Home/End - move
Enter - open folder / view file / install .pkg
Backspace - parent folder
Insert or Space - select
+ / - / * - select all / none / invert
F2 - refresh   F3 - view   F4 - edit text   Shift+F4 - new file
F5 - copy   F6 - move   Shift+F6 - rename   F7 - new folder
F8 or Delete - delete   F9 - permissions   I - install selected .pkg   N - network folders (SMB)
+ / - select / deselect by mask   * invert   Ctrl+A all
Ctrl+F or Alt+F7 - find files   Alt+Enter - properties   Ctrl+G - go to path
F10 or Esc - menu

Ctrl+D - download (a folder or several items come as a ZIP)

Drag files from your computer onto a panel to upload them.
On a touch screen: tap a row to select the cursor, tap again to open, tap the left cell to mark.
e_fuse_nofw: FUSE installation from a network share is not supported on firmware {v}. Copy the file to the console (F5) and install it from there.
editWeb: Full editing is available on the web interface (port 8484).
svc_noloader: BinLoader is off (GoldHEN - Servers - Enable Payloader Server).
noQr: QR code not found in the app
helpPad:
D-pad Up/Down - move (hold to scroll fast)
D-pad Left/Right - page up / down
Cross - open folder / confirm
Circle - parent folder / back
Square - mark file (cursor moves down)
Triangle - file menu (rename, select, properties, install .pkg)
L1 / R1 - switch panel
L2 / R2 - move along the bottom bar (1-10), Cross - run
Options - menu (theme, language, find, go to, network folders, log...)

Full text editing, upload and download are in the web interface (port 8484).
imgErr: Cannot display this image (PNG, JPG, BMP, GIF only)
noVideo: This video format is not supported by the console player (MP4, M4V, MOV only).
noFormat: This audio format is not supported in the app (MP3, OGG, WAV, M4A, AAC only).
appTooBig: File is too large for the app (limit 32 MB)
vidNoDecode: The video track ({c}) is not supported by the console player: audio only.
